description: Formal legal ontology defining corporate litigation parties, causes of action, court jurisdictions, precedents, and statutory remedies.

entity_classes.description: Corporate entities, individuals, or governmental agencies involved in litigation.
Judicial bodies and appellate courts with statutory jurisdiction.
Causes of action, claims, or statutory violations (e.g., BreachOfContract, PatentInfringement).
Binding or persuasive appellate legal precedents.
Court-awarded relief, damages, injunctions, or penalties.

allowed_relations.description: Plaintiff files an action or lawsuit against Defendant.
A legal claim is heard and decided by a specific court.
Court follows and applies binding precedent case law.
Precedent case establishes standard for awarding specific remedy.
Defendant party is held liable to pay or fulfill a legal remedy.
